craft_notes: Sthāyin: grant-joy. Close: wishing. Rejected: 'boons' — killed: fruit kept; 'whatever' flat — 'sought' kept.

lines: They come, give pledge, by Bhairava sped —
supreme fruition grant, whatever fruit is sought.
l4.sanskrit_cite: āgatya samayaṃ dattvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥ | yacchanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ phalaṃ yad vā samīhitam

reads_against.argmap: Come, pledged, Bhairava-urged — they give supreme accomplishment, whatever fruit wished.
c1_essence: Come, pledged, urged: supreme fruit, whatever wished.
